forecast-period.text: A high pressure system southeast of the state slowly drifts further to the southeast over Tasmania today and is forecast to be located in the Tasman Sea this afternoon, while extending a ridge over much of South Australia through to Tuesday. A trough of low pressure moves into far southwestern parts later on Tuesday and moves southeast across the state into Wednesday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Possible morning fog about the far west and southeast. Showers, tending to rain at times, about the northeast and extending southwest into the Eyre Peninsula throughout the day, with a slight chance of showers reaching further south about Kangaroo Island. Possible thunderstorms about the North East Pastoral and Flinders districts. Maximum temperatures below average in the north, grading to above average about the Southern Agricultural Area. East to northeasterly winds.

Showers possible across all districts, clearing in the west from the evening. Possible thunderstorms about about the North East Pastoral and Flinders districts. Maximum temperatures near to above average. North to northeasterly winds, freshening at times in the west, ahead of a west to southwesterly change extending across southern parts of the state from the evening. Winds tending east to southeasterly in the west from the evening.

text.p: Showers in the southeast easing by the afternoon and redeveloping in western parts, before extending southeast later. Possible thunderstorms about central and eastern districts later in the day. Maximum temperatures above average, tending near average in the west. Northeast to northwesterly winds, tending south to southeasterly in the west.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Wednesday: Broadly less than 3 mm across the state, increasing to falls of 5 to 15 mm about parts of the Agricultural Areas and parts of the Pastoral and Flinders districts. Isolated local falls of 15 to 30 mm possible about the northeast.

forecast-period.text: Showers across much of the state during Thursday, gradually contracting to the east of the state during Friday before clearing during Saturday. The chance of thunderstorms about the eastern districts. Daytime temperatures below average. Generally southwest to southeasterly winds.
